testsuite.name: com.uade.dda2.server.feature.auth.AdminUserInitializerTest

testcase.name: startup creates an active admin with an encoded password and repeated runs do nothing()
new admin requires an explicit strong bootstrap password()
existing mixed case username is never reset reactivated or assigned other roles()
existing admin gains citizen role without changing password status or other roles()
missing ADMIN role is created with the registered permissions()
new admin reuses the existing role and preserves its custom permissions()
new users assigned ADMIN also receive CIUDADANO immediately()
admin can authenticate as citizen and switch back without sharing permissions()
